description: Origin airport code for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Used as part of route-level grouping key

description: Destination airport code for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Used as part of route-level grouping key
notes_or_concerns: Includes one unusual route, EWR to LGA, with a single cancelled flight

description: Number of flights observed for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Count of flight records grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Ranges from 1 to 11,262; 10 routes have fewer than 10 flights, so their averages are unstable

description: Average departure delay for flights on the route, in minutes
transformation_or_derivation: Mean of dep_delay grouped by origin and dest

description: Average arrival delay for flights on the route, in minutes
transformation_or_derivation: Mean of arr_delay grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Missing for EWR to LGA (its only flight was cancelled); negative values mean early arrival on average

description: Longest arrival delay recorded for any single flight on the route, in minutes
transformation_or_derivation: Max of arr_delay grouped by origin and dest
notes_or_concerns: Driven by one extreme flight, so it is sensitive to outliers, less meaningful for routes with very few flights

description: Average flight distance for the route, in miles
transformation_or_derivation: Mean of distance grouped by origin and dest
notes_or_concerns: Distance is basically fixed for each route, so this is close to the route's actual distance rather than a true average

description: Average time spent in the air for flights on the route, in minutes
transformation_or_derivation: Mean of air_time grouped by origin and dest
notes_or_concerns: Cancelled flights have no air_time and are left out of the average; missing for EWR to LGA

description: Full name of the destination airport
